dataSource: MOEX ISS real quotes + MOEX official coupon rows + CBR 10Y
selectionRule: At each month-end choose real fixed OFZ SU262 with residual maturity >=7y and closest to 12y; roll using real MOEX full prices.
reason: Rolling proxy extends real-price evidence into D/E, but remains a proxy basket and requires robustness / leave-one-episode-out validation before production threshold change.

assumptions.durationMatching: residual maturity proxy around 12 years; not exact modified duration
